metadata.description: skraft agentic SDLC — the engineering pipeline (phase agents, adversarial reviewers, guardrails), the backlog plugin that triages and refines GitHub issues before it, and the brownfield plugin that makes a legacy codebase safe to change.

plugins.name: skraft
plugins.description: skraft SDLC pipeline — agents and skills for outside-in TDD, Clean Architecture and the RESEARCH→DESIGN→DISTILL→DELIVER engineering pipeline.

plugins.name: skraft-backlog
plugins.description: skraft backlog — discover and triage GitHub issues, refine them into ready stories, and review each issue's refinement in a comment, from your editor or a GitHub Agentic Workflow.

plugins.name: skraft-brownfield
plugins.description: skraft brownfield — characterize a legacy codebase into a PRD, lock its current behaviour under characterization tests, then refactor it safely with the Mikado Method or a Strangler Fig.
